title: Aspire Atlantis SE Replacement Coils - 5 Pack
description: These replacement Atlantis SE coils are built for use with the Aspire Atlantis GT sub-ohm tank - Super-stylish and highly durable DTL that is a collaboration between two industry giants, Taifun and Aspire, to create the ultimate sub ohm tank. These Atlantis SE sub-ohm mesh coils offer resistances of 0.35ohm, 0.3ohm, and 0.18ohms, all suited to drawing the maximum flavour and vapour out of your favourite High-VG E-liquid. Their mesh build ensures faster heat up times and better saturation of the coil, resulting in incredible flavour. Whether you're a cloud chaser or a flavour aficionado, these coils are sure to satisfy. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
